fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The rotation status values `'Legal'`, `'Not Legal'`, and `'Undecided'` were bare string literals scattered across 5 files, making them fragile to typos and hard to discover.

## What changed

Added a `RotationStatus(StrEnum)` class in `magic/rotation.py` with members `LEGAL = 'Legal'`, `NOT_LEGAL = 'Not Legal'`, and `UNDECIDED = 'Undecided'`. Because `StrEnum` members ARE strings (Python 3.11+, required by this project's `pyproject.toml`), existing DB column values and SQL wire format are unchanged. All 24 bare string literals in `magic/rotation.py`, `decksite/data/rotation.py`, `decksite/data/clauses.py`, `decksite/controllers/api.py`, and `discordbot/commands/history.py` were replaced with the enum members (SQL f-strings use `'{RotationStatus.X}'` to preserve SQL quoting).

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all 5 changed files)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit <touched files>` — 845 passed, 1 skipped (env-blocked functional test unrelated to this change)

Fixes #12304
